block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Background soundscapes, environmental loops, and ambient audio cues.
what_it_enables: Layered background soundscapes (BGS) playing beneath music and dialogue
Biome-specific environmental atmosphere (wind, water, distant wildlife, ethereal hum)
Continuous seamless looping with gentle volume fading on province boundaries
Ducking attenuation during dialogue cutscenes and victory fanfare
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations in audio cue routing (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Ambience routed strictly to bus_bgs mixing bus
Audio strictly follows simulation events: audio never drives combat turns

ambience_tracks.name: Sacyran Grassland Breeze & Rustling Leaves
ambience_tracks.description: Gentle temperate wind rustling through tall blades with soft insect chirps.

ambience_tracks.name: Libiran Dune Howl & Dust Swirls
ambience_tracks.description: Dry, gusting desert wind carrying fine grit across abandoned stone outposts.

ambience_tracks.name: Astral Void Resonance & Ethereal Chimes
ambience_tracks.description: Deep low-frequency cosmic drone punctuated by shimmering clockwork echoes.

ambience_tracks.name: Rushing Water & Rapids
ambience_tracks.description: Vigorous mountain stream tumbling across polished river stones.

tripwires.action: Clamp ambience volume scale to valid interval [0.0, 1.0]
